name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.2 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.2 adds an always-visible PLAY/CONTINUE control to playable Movie and Episode detail pages that delegates to Jellyfin's genuine local .btnPlay, while retaining the inline Identify workflow, duplicate resolution badges and confirmed direct deletion from v0.21.1.
